institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Unsafe pedestrian crossings, especially for persons with disabilities
description: PeSCo is a pedestrian signal controller that identifies crossing demands through push-button, RFID, and ultrasonic sensing technologies. The system adjusts crossing times according to user requirements and supports safer pedestrian movement at signalized intersections.
applications:
Smart city and intelligent transportation system (ITS) projects
Traffic management authorities and urban local bodies
Pedestrian safety and urban mobility infrastructure providers
Traffic signal equipment manufacturers and system integrators
Government agencies implementing road safety and inclusive mobility initiatives
